ticker: US Democrats win control of both chambers of Congress
IndiGo in advanced talks to buy 100 Embraer jets
India allocates ₹2,814 crore for critical mineral processing
England family doctors introduce early cancer blood tests
Novo Nordisk raises 2026 outlook following Wegovy success

articles.headline: IndiGo Explores Major Acquisition of 100 Embraer Jets
articles.brief: India's largest airline, IndiGo, is reportedly in discussions with aircraft manufacturer Embraer to procure up to 100 jets. This potential mega-deal marks a significant strategic move as the carrier looks to expand its regional connectivity and fleet capacity to meet surging domestic aviation demand.

articles.headline: Cabinet Approves ₹2,814 Crore Critical Mineral Scheme
articles.brief: The Indian government has greenlit a ₹2,814 crore scheme aimed at boosting domestic critical mineral processing capabilities. The initiative is designed to secure reliable supply chains for strategic sectors, positioning the country more competitively in advanced technology and manufacturing supply chains.

articles.headline: England Introduces World-First Blood Tests for Early Cancer
articles.brief: Family doctors across England are set to utilize innovative blood tests designed to spot cancer early, marking a world-first implementation in primary care. The rollout aims to drastically improve survival rates by catching aggressive malignancies before conventional symptoms manifest.

articles.headline: Novo Nordisk Raises 2026 Outlook on Wegovy Success
articles.brief: Pharmaceutical giant Novo Nordisk has upgraded its financial outlook for 2026 once again, driven by strong market adoption and stellar performance from its Wegovy pill. The milestone reflects soaring global demand for advanced weight-loss and metabolic therapies.

articles.headline: Democrats Win Both Chambers of US Congress in Midterms
articles.brief: In a major political shift, the Democratic Party has secured control of both the House and Senate in the 2026 midterm elections. The decisive surge presents substantial legislative roadblocks for Donald Trump's administration and impacts key federal policies.

articles.headline: Rahul Gandhi Issues Fresh Open Debate Challenge to Modi
articles.brief: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi has stepped up his political offensive against Prime Minister Narendra Modi, renewing an open challenge for a public debate. Gandhi criticized government policies while addressing supporters during ongoing campaign events.

articles.headline: Google Extends Voluntary Buyout Offers Globally
articles.brief: Tech giant Google has initiated voluntary buyout offers for employees across several international operations. The move is part of an ongoing corporate restructuring effort to streamline operations and optimize workforce distribution amid economic shifts.

articles.headline: Sam Altman Responds to Backlash Over PC RAM Remarks
articles.brief: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman temporarily changed his online handle after facing intense social media criticism over comments regarding the inefficiency of dedicated DRAM in personal computers. Critics argued his perspective overlooked practical consumer hardware needs.

articles.headline: Indian Stocks Post Longest Winning Streak in Five Months
articles.brief: Benchmark Indian equity indices extended their winning run to post their longest consecutive winning streak in nearly five months. Investor sentiment was largely buoyed by expectations of robust foreign portfolio investor inflows and favorable macroeconomic data.

articles.headline: Gold Prices Surge 3% Following US Midterm Results
articles.brief: Gold prices rallied approximately 3% as the US dollar weakened in the wake of significant Democratic gains in the midterm elections. Safe-haven demand intensified as markets priced in potential political gridlock and shifting fiscal dynamics.

articles.headline: Jacob Duffy Reflects on Virat Kohli's Brilliant Knock
articles.brief: New Zealand bowler Jacob Duffy shared his perspective on Virat Kohli's commanding performance during India's recent ODI victory in Auckland. Duffy acknowledged the challenges posed by Kohli's aggressive yet composed batting style on a difficult pitch.

articles.headline: India Secures Five-Wicket Triumph Over New Zealand
articles.brief: The Indian cricket team secured a comfortable five-wicket victory over New Zealand in their latest limited-overs fixture. Disciplined bowling restricted the visitors to a modest total before seasoned batsmen chased down the target with clinical efficiency.

articles.headline: Israel Begins Coalition Talks Following Uncontested Election
articles.brief: Following an election audit confirming no widespread fraud, Israeli leaders Benjamin Netanyahu and Benny Gantz have initiated formal coalition talks. The outcome of these negotiations will determine the formation of the next governing administration.

articles.headline: French Blood Plasma Storage Targeted in Cyberattack
articles.brief: Critical facilities managing French blood plasma storage have been hit by a sophisticated cyberattack as part of an expanding malicious campaign. Health authorities are working to secure infrastructure and ensure ongoing medical supply chain safety.

articles.headline: Delhi Air Quality Drops to 'Very Poor' Category
articles.brief: The national capital's air quality deteriorated into the 'very poor' category as thick smog blanketed Delhi ahead of the festive season. Meteorological factors and early winter pollution triggers have raised fresh concerns over public health.

articles.headline: Expert Panel Proposes 10-Year Stray Dog Management Plan
articles.brief: A committee of experts in Kerala has proposed a comprehensive ten-year roadmap to address the stray dog population issue. The recommendations shift focus from traditional catch-and-release programs toward institutional adoption and scientific waste management.
